verdict.rationale: PostHog's own flag release conditions match users by person properties, cohorts, and groups. That plausibly lets a developer target specific individuals or internal accounts, but per-user allowlisting is only implied and nothing documents exclusion. The early-access feature lets users opt themselves into betas, which is a different, user-driven capability and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit per-user ID/email targeting, documented exclusion/denylist conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: Person properties, cohorts, and groups decide who matches a release condition.
Create flags, set release conditions, schedule changes, and watch rollouts land.
